entities.summary: Cooperative Republic, a political institution in Guyana during Burnham's Cooperative Republic and Authoritarian Rule (1970–1985). Grew from Guyana declared a Cooperative Republic and Jonestown Massacre — November 18, 1978. Led to the emergence of Peoples Temple establishes Jonestown settlement and Nationalization of Booker McConnell sugar company.
